messages:
noah: Quick flag  we've been seeing bursts of packet drops on a subset of eu-west hosts coinciding with fractional-dedicated bursts. two pools reported >25% retries and a cascade of preemptions.

anya: Any vendor maintenance?

noah: Nothing on status pages. stack snippets show TCP retransmits between proxy and slot-manager and repeated preempt reasons: egress_congestion. sample:
```
[2026-08-11T03:04:12Z] slot-manager host=eu-west-2a-047 tx_retries=412 rx_drops=97 egress_bytes=1.3GB/min
[2026-08-11T03:04:13Z] allocator preempt tenant=fastbot slice=0.25 reason=egress_congestion
```

devon: Our token-bucket shaping is host-wide; fractional slices can still burst and bypass per-slice fairness. when NIC saturates, warm-pool spilling worsens cross-host traffic and loss.

pat: Proposal: host-local egress circuit-breaker with two behaviors: 1) soft-clamp that rejects new outbound connections for offending slices (429 with structured body), 2) force fallback routing to local quantized variants while clamp active. Include tenant opt-out for enterprise.

anya: We should avoid surprising SDK behavior. instead of silent 429s, return a structured degraded-mode message so clients can degrade gracefully (e.g., switch to async retry/backoff).

devon: Implementation sketch:
```
if host.nic_util > 85% and tenant.egress_rate > slice_threshold:
  clamp_duration = min(30s, tenant.sla_burst_window)
  emit host.egress_clamp{tenant}
  route.request -> local-quantized or return degraded-mode
```

pat: Cost tradeoff: local-quantized increases CPU but reduces retransmit waste. I'll run replay sims against 7 days of traffic to estimate p99 delta and bytes avoided.

anya: Ops rollout: canary on 5 hosts in eu-west-2a for 6h. monitors: host.pkt_retransmits, host.nic_util, allocator.preempt_count, tenant.sla_violations, metric:host.egress_clamp. alert if clamp_rate > 1/min.

infra-bot: experiment created by devon: egress-circuit-breaker v1 -> canary(eu-west-2a 5 hosts, 6h) monitors=[host.pkt_retransmits, host.nic_util, allocator.preempt_count, metric:host.egress_clamp].

noah: tagging @oncall to watch 03:00-06:00 UTC tomorrow. post replay results when ready. :ear:
